name: Khurana & Khurana (K&K)
india_angle: Khurana & Khurana has over 330 professionals across 10 Indian offices.
summary: Khurana & Khurana (K&K) is an IP and Commercial Law firm providing comprehensive services in intellectual property and commercial law. They offer patent drafting, IP procurement, and management services, which can support semiconductor companies in protecting and managing their intellectual assets.
